product.title: Sandboarding and Off Road in Lima (National Park Lomas de Ancón)

description.text: In Lima, this private 4x4 outing heads north to Lomas de Ancón for guided dune driving and sandboarding. Hotel pickup, sandboarding equipment, a certified instructor, and snacks are included after a safety briefing, and no prior sandboard experience is required. The published route stays on the Ancón reserve dunes rather than a long southbound Huacachina transfer. Airbnb pickups are asked to stay within a 20-mile radius of Lima. The format suits visitors who want a guided off-road window close to the capital without booking a 17-hour desert coach. A local dessert stop on the return is mentioned on the product page. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Lima, and the itinerary stays on Lomas de Ancón and Ancón that define this sandboard day rather than a Paracas boat or vineyard add-on.
